findings.title: Continue provides no visible response
findings.reported_issue: The reviewer says that pressing Continue produces no visible response and that a second attempt also does not work.
findings.detailed_description: The reviewer reports that Continue produces no visible response in two separate attempts. The sampled states remain on checkout step 2 of 3 with standard delivery selected and no visible error or next-step state. Because the recording has no visible click indicator, the evidence supports the unchanged interface state but cannot establish whether the input event was registered.
findings.visible_state: Checkout remains on step 2 of 3 with standard delivery selected, Continue visible, and no error or next-step state.
findings.reviewer_intent: The reviewer expects either the next step or a clear error message.
findings.observation: The checkout remains on step 2 of 3 in both sampled states. The recording has no visible click indicator.
findings.reviewer_expectation: Either the next step or a clear error message.
transcript_evidence: 00:22.720–00:31.520: I select standard delivery and press continue. Nothing happens. There is no visible response, so I cannot tell whether the click was registered.
00:46.720–00:53.360: I try continue again. The button still does not work. I would expect either the next step or a clear error message.
unknown_context: Whether the input event was registered
uncertainty_notes: The recording has no visible click indicator, so it cannot establish whether the input event was registered.

findings.title: Discount message overlaps the order total
findings.reported_issue: The reviewer says that the discount message overlaps the total and makes the final amount difficult to read.
findings.detailed_description: The discount confirmation is rendered across the Total row and visibly covers both its label and amount. This directly supports the reported readability problem, while the intended placement, duration, responsible component, and root cause remain unstated.
findings.visible_state: The Discount applied: SAVE10 message covers the Total label and amount.
findings.reviewer_intent: The reviewer wants the final amount to remain readable.
findings.observation: The Discount applied: SAVE10 message visibly covers the total label and amount.
findings.reviewer_expectation: The final amount should remain readable.
transcript_evidence: 01:08.720–01:18.560: There is another issue in the order summary. The discount message overlaps the total, which makes the final amount difficult to read.
unknown_context: The intended placement or duration of the discount message
findings.interpretation: Layout and readability defect in the order summary.
